pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: King's Knight's Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White attacking down an h-file that only Black uses (White has no rook on h1) with Qe1-h4; plan 4 had an h6-f5 route without the knight; plan 2 had ...Qh4 through the g5-pawn. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 (a first plan 1 naming Nd4/Nh2 was rejected by the reviewer as unconfirmed).

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Lolli Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Qh5+ through the g4-pawn; plan 2 had ...Kg7. Rewrote both around 5...Kxf7 6.Ne5+ Ke8 7.Qxg4 Nf6 8.Qxf4; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: McDonnell Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Qxf3 before ...gxf3 and O-O-O with the c1-bishop at home. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plans 3-4.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Middleton Countergambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Kh1 into the open h-file; plan 2 had ...Qh4 through the g5-pawn. Rewrote both (a first plan 1 naming Nd4/Nh2 was rejected by the reviewer as unconfirmed).

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Muzio Gambit, Brentano Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Qxf3 before ...gxf3 and Re1 piling on f7. Rewrote it (6.exd5 or 6.Bxd5); British spelling in overview and plan 4.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Rosentreter Gambit, Bird Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 named weak squares f2 and h2 (f2 empty): rewritten and accepted; plan 1 now says half-open f-file. Plan 3 gives an illegal 7.Qxg3 line; two rewrites around 6...fxg3 7.Qxg4 g2+ 8.Qxh4 gxh1=Q were rejected by the reviewer, so the old text is kept and needs research.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Salvio Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 4 had h4 with Black's queen on h4. Rewrote plans 1 and 4 (6.Kf1; round up the f4- and g4-pawns); British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Salvio Gambit, Silberschmidt Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 had h4 with Black's queen on h4. Rewrote plan 3; half-open f-file and British spelling in overview and plan 1.

pages.name: KGA: Philidor Gambit, Schultz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had the queen going to g3 or h3 through the f3-knight and d5 as a bare move. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: KGA: Kieseritsky, Brentano Defence, Kaplanek Variation
pages.notes: Plans called the b4-bishop's line a pin after 9.Kf2 had already broken it, and gave Bxc3 as a White move. Rewrote both plans (the c3-knight now hits the d5-queen); British spelling in overview.
